title: Joints and a ragdoll on hull parts
note: First joints entry: a door hinge at its 100 degree limit, a chain, a rope, a slider at its end and a weld, with the joints overlay and its drawn legend; then a Sepulcra shambler knocked over as a ragdoll whose parts are convex hulls fitted to its mesh, lying on its back (it sat on its coat with round capsules), and the hull overlay.
